acceptance_rule: Archive and hash every official result XML used; validate PIT auction date, CUSIP, tenor and bid-to-cover; settle at least 30 non-overlapping trades and at least 10 per window. Accepted alpha requires all three window EV and PnL deltas nonnegative, aggregate EV delta >0.5286 and PnL delta >10432.91, worst drawdown no more than 0.5pp worse, positive mean cash and QQQ replacement value in every window, DSR probability >=0.95 using 7 effective attempts, top-tenor positive-PnL share <=35%, and top-five trade positive-PnL share <=60%. A merely positive result remains default-off observed-only.
